properties.description: Ahrensburg culture, one outline: Netherlands, N Belgium, N Germany to the Oder, Denmark, S Sweden, southern Doggerland (cut to the land of 10,000 BC); eastern and northern England (Flixton, Sewell's Cave, Three Ways Wharf, item 49); central uplands and the Ardennes: Hohler Stein (Sauerland), Kartstein (Eifel), Remouchamps (item 78). The gaps between the former three pieces (western Doggerland, Dover) are filled so that the zone is one outline.
